subject: Marketplace Syndication: ISV + Consultancy Joint Listing and co-sell routing
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cloudadvisors.io>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint listing request + proposed co-sell routing

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Nimbus is excited to move a joint Marketplace listing forward: we have two ISV SKUs (inference bundle + consulting retainer) that would benefit from CloudAdvisors acting as the implementation partner for initial deployments.

Quick asks to get this started:
- Can Redwood host a joint listing with both ISV and consulting SKUs visible in AWS/GCP catalogs?
- What evidence / technical artifacts do you need from Nimbus and CloudAdvisors for co-sell certification?
- Who from Redwood should be the technical contact for the catalog integration?

I attached a high-level listing outline and a one-page mutual action plan. Open to a 30-minute sync this week.

Attachments: nimbus-redwood-joint-listing-outline.pdf (PDF), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX)

Best,
Asha Rao
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus Analytics
asha.rao@nimbusanalytics.com
+1 (415) 555-4182

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cloudadvisors.io>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint listing request + proposed co-sell routing

Hi Asha —

Appreciate the clear deck. Short answer: yes, we can do a joint listing that surfaces both the ISV SKU and the consultancy services, but there are a few gating items. I copied the partners and marketplace leads.

Top things we need to unblock:
1) Technical artifacts for the ISV SKU (container image or model hash, sample inference profile, endorsement test).
2) Co-sell evidence: joint customer reference or pilot agreement + implementation runbook from CloudAdvisors.
3) Pricing matrix for both SKUs (list + co-sell discounts / referral splits).

Ben, Olga, Marissa — can you confirm the marketplace evidence checklist and who will own the catalog entry?

Asha / Tom — I can do a short kickoff Thursday 11am PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and an initial pre-read request.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Asha Rao <asha.rao@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint listing request + proposed co-sell routing

Vivek / team —

Quick notes from a commercial/sales angle:
- We typically require a primary external account (Nimbus) to own the ISV listing and list Redwood as an integration partner; Services partners (CloudAdvisors) are listed as implementation partners.
- For co-sell routing we can set up partner routing rules in our console: lead-owner attribution (Nimbus) but allow CloudAdvisors to claim implementation opportunities.
- Need clarity on discounts / referral % before we publish; suggest we table exact numbers in the MAP (mutual action plan).

I’ll bring the customer motion playbook to the kickoff so we can align on lead flow and entitlement.

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cloudadvisors.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 04 Jul 2028 08:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint listing request + proposed co-sell routing

Thanks — confirms we’re aligned. A few operational asks from CloudAdvisors:
- We need a sandbox listing environment (staging catalog) to validate SKU entitlement and meter hooks before going live.
- Implementation runbook template (preferred format: markdown + example IaC snippets) so our engineers can scope rolling deployments.
- Any guardrails around customer data flows when the consulting engagement includes on-prem / VPC installs.

We should also capture preferred lead routing: initial inbound goes to Nimbus for licensing, CloudAdvisors gets automatic implementation-intent tag and can request an introduction.

Tom Ellis
Director, Cloud Partnerships
CloudAdvisors LLC
+1 (617) 555-1226
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@nimbusanalytics.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cloudadvisors.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, AWS Partner Manager <am-partnermgr@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Jul 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint listing request + proposed co-sell routing — actions and owners

All —

Great sync this morning. Summary of agreed next steps and owners:

1) Marketplace evidence checklist (Olga) — deliver by Tue 07/10: expected artifacts: integration test report, security questionnaire answers, sample billing SKU metadata.
2) Staging listing access (Marissa) — Marissa to provision staging entry and invite Nimbus/CloudAdvisors by 7/11.
3) Mutual action plan finalization (Nimbus/CloudAdvisors) — Asha/Tom to update MAP with referral splits and attach customer pilot name by 7/12.
4) Technical contact & runbook (Karthik + CloudAdvisors) — scope runbook template and IaC examples; draft due 7/14.
5) Lead routing configuration (Ben) — Ben to propose lead tag rules and entitlement flow for review 7/13.

Related links: Drive pre-read (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-nimbus-joint-listing), HubSpot record HubSpot: 004832-ND.

I’ll follow up with a one-page rollout timeline and calendar invites. If anyone needs to escalate to AWS partner PM for co-sell enablement, I’ve cc’d the AM.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into staging.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-9083
